remarks: Welcome to 5 Fillow St, a spacious Colonial offering 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and over 2,350sqft of living space. Designed for comfortable everyday living and effortless entertaining, this home features generously sized rooms, functional floor plan, and plenty of natural light. This property offers a flexible layout with exciting potential for extending living arrangements or possible in-law set up. Step outside to enjoy a private backyard, offering space to relax, garden or entertain. Conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, parks, schools, Metro North, and Major highways. This Property truly combines comfort, convenience, and versatility in the Heart of Norwalk.
